Name: Cuter Possums
Author: Ellillilliott
Description:
[font=Tahoma][color=#f9cb9c][size=6]7.15:
[CP] version is available.[/size][/color]
[size=5]
A little tweak for possums,make them looks [color=#f4cccc]tinier[/color] and [color=#ead1dc]cuter,[/color]

If you're afraid of possums, try this mod.

I've also provided an option to [/size][color=#a4c2f4][size=5]remove the possum.[/size]
[/color]
[size=6]Install:[/size]
[size=5][color=#f4cccc]1.XNB version:[/color][list]
[*][font=Tahoma][color=#f4f4f4]Download this mod and unzip it,[/color][/font]
[*][font=Tahoma][color=#f4f4f4]Overwrite [/color][color=#999999]critters.xnb[/color][color=#f4f4f4] in [/color][/font][font=Tahoma][color=#ffd966][size=5]Stardew Valley\Content\TileSheets.[/size][/color][/font]
[/list][color=#ffd966]
[/color][/size][/font][size=5][font=Arial][color=#f4cccc]2.[CP] version:[/color]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Arial]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url],[/font]
[*][font=Arial]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods/,[/font]
[*][font=Arial]Run the game using SMAPI.[/font]
[/list][/size]
[size=6]——Thanks——[/size]
[size=5]Thanks [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/messenger/5732816/#]ttanday[/url] for giving me this idea.
[/size]
